shortDescription: Manage DNS records on BIG-IP ZoneRunner

options.name: algorithm
options.description: Specifies The algorithm used to calculate the key. Required when (type=DS). Supported only for (type=DS).

options.name: cname
options.description: Specifies The cname of the record. Required when (type=CNAME). Supported only for (type=CNAME).

options.name: digest
options.description: Specifies The digest type identifies the digest algorithm used. Required when (type=DS). Supported only for (type=DS).

options.name: digest_type
options.description: Specifies The digest type identifies the digest algorithm used. Required when (type=DS). Supported only for (type=DS).

options.name: domain_name
options.description: Specifies the domain name of the record.

options.name: flags
options.description: Specifies A character string containing flags to control interpretation of the remaining fields in the record. Required when (type=NAPTR). Supported only for (type=NAPTR).

options.name: hardware
options.description: Specifies The hardware info for this record. Required when (type=HINFO). Supported only for (type=HINFO).

options.name: host_name
options.description: Specifies The hostname of the Name Server. Required when (type=NS). Supported only for (type=NS).

options.name: ip_address
options.description: Specifies The ip address of the record. Required when (type=A, AAA, PTR). Supported only for (type=A, AAA, PTR).

options.name: key_tag
options.description: Specifies The keytag of the KEY record. Required when (type=DS). Supported only for (type=DS).

options.name: label
options.description: Specifies The label of the record. Required when (type=DNAME). Supported only for (type=DNAME).

options.name: mail
options.description: Specifies The mail-exchanger for this record. Required when (type=MX). Supported only for (type=MX).

options.name: order
options.description: Specifies The order in which the records MUST be processed. Required when (type=NAPTR). Supported only for (type=NAPTR).

options.name: os
options.description: Specifies The OS info for the record. Required when (type=HINFO). Supported only for (type=HINFO).

options.name: port
options.description: Specifies The port for this service. Required when (type=SRV). Supported only for (type=SRV).

options.name: preference
options.description: Specifies The preference to use for this record. Required when (type=MX, NAPTR). Supported only for (type=MX, NAPTR).

options.name: priority
options.description: Specifies The priority to use for this record. Required when (type=SRV). Supported only for (type=SRV).

options.name: regexp
options.description: Specifies A string containing a substituion expression. Required when (type=NAPTR). Supported only for (type=NAPTR).

options.name: replacement
options.description: Specifies The next NAME to query for NAPTR, SRV or address records. Required when (type=NAPTR). Supported only for (type=NAPTR).

options.name: reverse
options.description: Indicating whether PTR records should automatically be generated. When (reverse=0) the module will not to generate PTR When (reverse=1) the module will attempt to generate the specified PTR Supported only for (type=A, AAA).

options.name: service
options.description: Specifies The service(s) available down this rewrite path. Required when (type=NAPTR). Supported only for (type=NAPTR).

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the DNS record. When l(state=present) the module will attempt to create the specified DNS record if it does not already exist. When l(state=absent), the module will remove the specified DNS record.

options.name: target
options.description: Specifies The target to use for this record. Required when (type=SRV). Supported only for (type=SRV).

options.name: text
options.description: Specifies The text entry for the record. Required when (type=TXT). Supported only for (type=TXT).

options.name: ttl
options.description: Specifies the TTL for this record.

options.name: type
options.description: Specifies the type of DNS zone

options.name: view_name
options.description: Specifies the name of the View.

options.name: weight
options.description: Specifies The weight to use for this record. Required when (type=SRV). Supported only for (type=SRV).

options.name: zone_name
options.description: Specifies the name of the DNS zone. The name must begin with a letter and contain only letters, numbers, and the underscore character.
